case.title: Design: grid errors show in a Save is blocked banner
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A on % Off.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 120 in tier A's first range.
  5. Click Save.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The cell reads 120.

Step 5:

  • A pink banner under the simulator reads "Save is blocked" and tier A's name followed by ": enter a % from 0 to 99.99 in every range.", as in picture 3.15.
